description: Searches publicly visible timeshare rental stays on vakaymood.com by place, resort, date window, sleeping capacity, nightly price and brand. Returns stays with fixed dates, itemized pricing in USD and the vakaymood.com URL where each stay is booked. All parameters are optional and combinable. Each result is a summary: the bed configuration, kitchen equipment, cancellation terms, VakayFlex option, notices, unit amenities and unit policies of a stay are returned by get_listing for its listingId, and the policies and published questions and answers of its resort by get_resort for its resort.id.

checkin.description: Start of the search window, YYYY-MM-DD.

checkout.description: End of the search window, YYYY-MM-DD.

location.description: Free-form place name, matched against resort country, state and city. Example: Orlando Florida.

max_nightly_price.description: Upper bound on the nightly rate in USD.

resort.description: One resort, given as an RR code (RR12345678) or a resort slug from a previous result.

sort.description: Result ordering. start_asc (default) orders by check-in date, then nightly price.

name: search_availability
title: Search available stays
